label: Romanisation · the title
rom: So Yaldol
english: III.1 · Of Their Raising

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Bremm hosast et tynur.
english: *The first autumn of the siege.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadhant et vennuldath, hos ul hos cumm, amm re voll Kael Nydherd so; eth re ston gor uld dem dessyl, hosen ul vimm et movenn. Re weske Halyna et scaevureleth ul et vestul sa re lymmym. Galat sa re yal ulont eth ul dumol nahos, re veskym o ul garm.
english: *Laid by the True Men, each for his own haven, as Kael the Counter called them, and every man stood to answer, as under the banner. {{Halyna}} had found the rolls in the chest I carried. What was in them and in no man's memory, I read out.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom. Nath reskym; es stonom. Lo vollol stonant uldath.
english: Give me the stone. No, I will stand. At a roll men stand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et dhess re orrom dem susk et taldow rerddhalden. Hy et taldow ull doss veskyl Orrow tul, dem et myst. Nath lusk hos odh umo dhidh dem susk.
english: At first light I went up the east tower. From there that coast may be seen yet, as far as the haze. Not one hearth on it sendeth up smoke.

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm sy hunna vollath et cummath, eth ketha so, hy vodh dossant lor.
english: Hear now the names of the havens, and hold them, for they are ours.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hinnar uld ullen, nath gadhom o. Vollom et cumm, eth es dess uld et cumm sost, eth es ryt vodh es nald o, amm es mymm et cumm dem varn. El rytvard en. Kethym so.
english: Another man's city I tell not. I call the haven, and its own man shall answer, and swear what he will do when it is come home. Oath-keeper am I. I hold them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hosast re veskym hy et scaevureleth, hosen re haral o. Ew galdardath ol nedheth, new wadhardath. Re yal ludal et wadh lunnat umont, eth re yaldant ul vodh ommant et brunnath dem et wadh lo ommolath sell; eth re hadhant orrolath um et brunnath hosen lorrdhrenneth. Cadh gor scaevurel et tolm hosast lo hos trenn: Orl sy re yal et trenn hosast cadhat, eth hulter stinet dem et galdat. El lyss garl et saevulath, eth vothen, hosen amm nath re vallant vyssorol et flenn. Ew galdat Stonwrytan gor hald ul noth cumm. Noth cumm, eth noth hulter.
english: *First I read from the rolls, as he bade me. Builders were our fathers, and no seafarers. The open water they feared, and built where the mountains go down in long falls to the sea, and over the mountains they paved roads like veins. Each haven's roll beginneth with the one line:* This day was the first course laid, and a staff cut for the work. *Small is the clerks' hand, and patient, as if they were loath to waste the leaf. Every wall of the ten was Stonewright work. Ten havens, and ten staffs.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Tavow Hemm, et cumm hemm sost.
english: **Eldhythe, the Eldest Haven.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Corlen Dhavow. Pa vurr eth noth surr re lymm hyll et hedh et sultereth dem varn lo sest en davow, niss, dem et tavowlesteth dhaedh sost ul Morrow. Ol sulter hosast sa es mymm dem varn, es davom o. Ston.
english: Corlen of the harbour. Fifty years the evening tide brought the boats home past my quay, slow, to the warmest harbour-houses on the coast. The first boat of ours to come home, I will steer it in.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Hy ull re resk Corlen, hemm sost et Delv, eth re heth o nind thenth dem susk, hosen gor fedh ul et kethyl um et hald. Nath noss helvhoss ul et hellur sy. Re dhyvullant et uldath tevel ul sestow. Re vysk o lont galat sa vysk o lo o wramman, amm maverent brammol: Tovva. Nath dunn et wadh tul.
english: *Then Corlen sat, eldest of the Twelve, and wet a finger and held it up, as at every holding on the wall. There is no wind in this hall. The young men at the back laughed. To them he said what he saith to his gunners when they would fire: "Wait. The sea hath not finished."*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Cemm Hyll, ul vodh cemm et rhull et hyll.
english: **Tidesmeet, where the river meeteth the tide.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Tamm Sull Heskal. Um et pa hless re ston o, eth re lodhant sull heskal strom o um et rhull.
english: Tamm of the three spans. On both banks it stood, and three great spans bound it across the water.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re hadh Tamm sull tolm lo et vorr, ul so dhrenn, hosen lo o naeval gor vess.
english: *Tamm set three stones out by the fire, in their order, as by his blanket every night.*

label: Romanisation
rom: El crynir hos heskal. El hinnar sull. Um et cless ul vodh re stonant, es gadhom so. Ston.
english: One span is a plank. Three is a city. On the bank where they stood, I will set them out.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Sedhnell, et hinnar sa re yal gor fedh ul felmyl.
english: **Fenholm, the town that was always sinking.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Marl Sedhen. Re ston ol gumm um yannath, eth re felm o ryssyth yarl gor hossol, eth re hadh gor dhesk trenn clenn um et trenn hemm. Uld sedhen sa nath dhyvull um ull, el uld wrunnel o.
english: Marl the fen-born. Our town stood on pilings, and sank a hand's breadth a lifetime, and every generation laid a new course on the old. A fen-man that cannot laugh at that had best go and live on a hill.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadh Ebba hemm, en scaelur, trenn dasken ol lest. Doss tolm hyo ul en havul, eth es lymmym ey sost, amm lusk ey en ul lymmyl. Doss ey lo ull, lo et vorr, ul ferryl. Es gadhom tolm Ebba um et trenn hemm. Ston.
english: Old Ebba, my grandmother, laid the last course of our house. A stone of it is in my pack, and I would carry her too, if she would let me. She is there by the fire, nodding. I am to lay her stone on the old course.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Lurrvard, et kethow ul vimm et crisur lurr.
english: **Holtward, the keep under the canopy.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Aske Hrisur Lurr. Re yal o sost virr ul molt et mesketh, hy ull re orr orrard ul vimm, eth nath re vesk o hald. Nath re stiner hos gend; eth gor wremm re lunnar et haldorrol hy et flenneth lo yarl.
english: Aske of the canopy. It lay so close among the trees that a traveller might pass under it and see no wall. No bough would we cut, and every autumn we swept the wall-walk of its leaves by hand.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re firr kaelirvesk et vess lo et odh. Um gor hrynir hyo re hadh Aske o yarl, somm nath re orr o dem et vorr tul.
english: *By the hearth lay the night's wreck-wood. On every plank of it Aske laid his hand, ere it went on the fire.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew mesketh so hos fedh. Nath narr dannwresk ul Lurrvard somm hossom. Ston.
english: These were trees once. No axe shall come into Holtward while I live.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Kethow Stellath, kethow et stelleth.
english: **Carnhold, the stronghold of the cairns.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Garvel Runnowath. Re stannar o ul molt stelleth et stannardath hosast, eth re yal seskyl lo uld hy et bontol, vodh drunnow re yal ul vorr. Gor wramm um et hald sy, rernym o, hosen rern odha hoss gask. Myskent venn brammath sa wontant venn. Veth um runndholm ul Gethow Stellath es nald galat sa nel bramm, eth es hunnom o ul montol. Ston.
english: Garvel of the smithies. We hewed it among the cairns of the first quarrymen, and a man could tell by the ring which of its forges was at work. Every gun on this wall I listen to, as a mother to a cough. Guns that ring true speak true. But at an anvil of Carnhold I will make a thing that is not a gun, and hear it ring.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Tavow Vorr, et drunnow um et orrow sa vorr.
english: **Emberhythe, the forge on the burning shore.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Harl Orrow sa Vorr. Re ston o ul vodh orr dhidh et brunn dem et wadh, eth re yal et trun sost dhaedh, hy ull re haskant ol devath lo visketh naesket um et sulv. Es gethym pawast et orrow sa vorr, eth es vorrom et myst, eth et wadh sost, amm grik o vorr. Ston.
english: Harl of the burning shore. It stood where the mountain smoketh into the sea, and the ground was so warm that our children ran barefoot in the snow. My shore I will have again, and the grey I will burn, and the sea too, if it would take fire.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Grullsorth, et kethow rytet ul hald et thykir.
english: **Sandreach, the citadel carved in the canyon wall.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ulden Salereth. Nath re yal tavow lo. Veth re vollar o: cumm, hy vodh re var o ol. Nath re yal galdat, veth paskat, saler ul vimm saler ul et hal unth. Gor vess dem et Ommol re aedhym ul vimm et brunn tunn, hosen ul vimm en grisur, eth en rern um et pressir; eth re hunnom o ul gethyl. Ul vimm et crisur ull es naedhym pawast. Ston.
english: Ulden of the galleries. Sandreach had no harbour. We called it a haven all the same, for it sheltered us. Dug it was, not built, gallery below gallery into the red rock. Every night till the havens fell I slept with the whole mountain for my roof, and mine ear to the floor, and heard it hold. Under that roof I will sleep again.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Frennvar, et par um et lynth crentet.
english: **Rimewatch, the watch on the frozen mere.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Hesk Lynth. Lo dhrenn et grem re ston et hellur strom um et crest, eth re nask et hinnar ul vimm o hrisur ul hylenn, eth re yal dhaedh. Hedh eth hedh re orr tymornel disker eth disker, eth re lestirent et grellereth et sugornath um et crest dem varn. Re voth en modha et grellereth ull. Doss hos hyont ul vorr um et hald bridlernen vess sy. Pawast es syndalom o um et crest. Ston.
english: Hesk of the mere. All winter its great hall stood out on the ice, and the town feasted under its roof, and was warm. Every dusk a taper went from window to window, and the fishers out on the ice steered home by the lamps. My mother kept those lamps. One of them is lit on the north wall tonight. On the ice I will light it again.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Taldow Helv, taldow et tolmath sa haemerent.
english: **Highreach, the tower of the floating stones.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Lanner Gynten. Re yal et gynteth sost susk, hy ull re orr gor dhrenn dem susk um wemmerdeth, eth re haemer o um et helvhoss, hosen haemerent ganurnasath ul susk et trunow. Doss mummol helvhoss lom hos orl tevar. Hossvell luld et gynteth ull helvhoss dem susk, somm nath noss orrol lo tul. Es nystym pawast et gynt susk sost, eth es hossvellym dem et helvhoss. Ston.
english: Lanner of the crags. So high were its crags that every course went up on cranes, and hung on the wind as hawks hang over a field. A wind I can smell a day off. A boy of those crags can whistle one up ere he can walk. I will climb the highest again, and whistle for the wind.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Eth Sirrvell, et dasken eth et deth sost.
english: **And Glasspire, the last and proudest.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Pellow Vell. Re yald dhom tesk o, eth re rik o et rerd hosen preller hrest. Lo wisk re ston et sirr strom, sa re rig et rerd farrol orl dem neld ul et myst. Re rasor en nedh o. Galat hyo sa re lymmym dem susk et brunn lo wroclinth, re rasorom o ul ol sirreth dem neld. Amm es mymm Sirrvell dem varn, hosast es veskym o. Ston.
english: Pellow of the spire. Seven generations raised it, and it caught the sun like a blade of ice. At the top stood the great glass, that threw the sun a day's sail out into the grey. My father ground it. What I carried of it up the mountain in straw, I have ground into our far-glasses. When Glasspire is come home, mine shall be the first eye on it.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Hy ull re heth Pellow, tevel sost et Delv, o sirr dem susk lo et vorr, hosen keth o o dem susk gor fedh, eth lo o naskol sost. Re vysk o lo et tevath ul lern: Veska virr.
english: *Then Pellow, youngest of the Twelve, held his glass up to the fire, as he holdeth it up to everything, his supper among the rest. To the children at the front he said, "Look close."*

label: Romanisation
rom: Noth hinnar, noth tavow, noth lonn sa re vollant so sost hos lunt.
english: Ten cities, ten harbours, ten kindreds that called themselves one nation.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vimm et movenn re dhesser delv hyor. Re rytent noth vess sy. Re ryt Stannard Sorth nayalat, hy vodh new cumm et sorth fedh. Re runn o hos fedh um et odhdholm lo o nindyorn. Nath hebb o osk lo dholm dem drunnol umo.
english: Twelve of us answered under the banner. Ten have sworn tonight. Stannard of the ridge sware naught, for the ridge was never a haven. He knocked once on the hearthstone with his knuckle. No stone will he trust till he have knocked on it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re hadhom noth cumm vess sy, eth noth ryt, kethym so. Nath noss cumm lom.
english: Ten havens have I told tonight, and ten oaths I hold. I have no haven.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re wesk et Crenn en lo orrol.
english: The Captain found me on a road.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*

label: Romanisation · the title
rom: So Ommol
english: III.2 · Of Their Fall

label: Romanisation · the dateline
rom: Grem pawast, ul Hyll Pawast.
english: *The second winter, in the Second Tide.*

label: Romanisation · Seren’s headnote
rom: Re hadhant et vennuldath pawast, gor uld um ommol o hinnar sost, ul vess frenn duss, amm re wrident et brammath, eth nath re hyn et lodh tul. Re voll Kael Nydherd so, eth re vyskym hosen brodow et Stonwrytan.
english: *Laid by the True Men again, each for the fall of his own city, on a night of hard frost when the guns were cooling and the mortar was not yet set. Kael the Counter called them, and I spake for the guild.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Hebb et tolm lom. Nath reskym; es stonom. Nel dem reskyl et trenn sy.
english: Give me the stone. No, I will stand. This is no tale to sit for.

label: Romanisation
rom: Vollath et cummath, re hethys so ul et bremm. Ketha so amm sy lo dhrenn et ommol, eth nath veska dem neld, hy vodh nath re vesker dem neld ul et brodhol.
english: Their names ye held in the autumn. Hold them now through the falling, and look not away, for we looked not away in the telling.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul heth dasken et sollan, murr bress tevar hy et movenn, re yaldant et lodhnasath nasowath ul grernil gor yanna. Nath re hresk hos hy et cummath nasow fedh. Nath re yal scethan yorrol lo et cummath. Re yalant haldath et cummath galdat dem dernil eth dem helv. Re yal gor yanna ryss, eth re ston lunnat ul vess.
english: In the last spring of the peace, twenty months ere the banner, the swallows nested in the arches of the gates. No man of the havens ever broke a nest. The havens had no fleet of war. Their walls were built for the high days and the weather. Their gates were wide, and stood open at night.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy et myst re rarrant et wemmeth domm, eth nath re yal peltir. Nath re vellor luskat sa re hyrril hos, veth drunnol hy et myst, hosen brammol helv; eth nath re hess o. Vollant et hesperdeth um et hald sy o: et drunnatath. Re raevular crenn um et scetheth ull, eth cryrull, eth hos uld lo hos bunth. Re ston nahos um et pressireth. Rytom um ull. Ston.
english: Out of the grey, without warning, came the dark sails. No envoy came that any man could understand, but a knocking out of the grey, like thunder, on and on. The soldiers on this wall call it the drums. We looked for a captain on those ships, and a crew, and one man at one rope. No one stood on the decks. I swear to that.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re vollar o: scethan dhenn; eth et luskardath: Mystaeri, voll hy et myst. Maver uld voll dem o sennyl.
english: So we called it the ghost fleet, and its senders the Mystaeri, after the mist. A man must call his death by some name.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ew nestorn et wemmeth ull hy et wemmeth sa orrant ul ol lern amm sy. Re rarr gor wemm hosel, eth nath re yal maver ullen umo. Nath re lusk hos cumm dem mullen dem renn, hy vodh nath re yal renn lo hos dem luskol.
english: Plainer were those sails than the sails that come against us now. Each came alone, and needed no more. No haven sent to another for help, for none had any help to send.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Hy ull re hadh gor uld o yarl um et tolm, hos eth hos, Corlen hosast.
english: *Then each laid his hand on the stone in his turn, Corlen first.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Tavow Hemm.
english: **Eldhythe.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul ryst hosast et heth ull re vellorant et wemmeth domm lo wrodow et tavow, um et hyll sa dhald. Hy et dhess dem et hedh re vorr et tavow: et sultereth bysket hosast, eth hy ull et tavowlesteth, ul vodh re reskent higileth Orrow tunn lo et vorr.
english: On the first morning of that spring the dark sails came in at the harbour mouth, on the flood. From dawn to dusk the harbour burned: the boats at their moorings first, then the harbour-houses, where the ship-masters of all the coast had sat at the fire.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Hy ull re dhovv o, hosen lo o wrammath, eth re dhovv et hellur lo o sest.
english: *Then he waited, as at his guns, and the hall waited with him.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et hedh re hadh et helvhoss et dhidh um et hinnar, hy ull nath re vesk et hinnar et tavow ul morrol. Sull bress re heth o, eth ul hedh dasken re vellor et hyll um et vorrdhuss, niss, hosen re vellor o gor fedh; eth nath re dhunn et wadh tul.
english: At evening the wind laid the smoke across the city, so that the city saw not its harbour go. Three months it held, and on the last evening the tide came in over the ash, slow, as it always came, and the sea had not finished.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re rik Corlen o yarl hy et tolm, eth re heth Tamm et tolm. Ew et fedh dasken sa re heth Corlen o.
english: *Corlen took his hand from the stone for Tamm. It was the last time he held it.*

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Cemm Hyll.
english: **Tidesmeet.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Sull orl re omm o. Hy et orrol susk re vesker et sull heskal ul mommol dem vimm ul et rhull, eth re hunnar so ul morrol. Re orr et heskal susk, eth hy ull et heskal vimm. Re ston et heskal ul molt sell sost, eth re dhovvar umo, eth re orr o. Vess ull re yystym dem vimm ul et domm, eth re rikym tolm hyont gor hos.
english: Three days it took. From the high road we watched its three spans go down into the river, and heard them go. The upper went, and then the lower. The middle stood longest, and we waited for it, and it went. That night I climbed down in the dark, and took a stone of each.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Sedhnell.
english: **Fenholm.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul hos vess re felm o, hosen amm nath re yal et sedh veth ul dovvol. Hinnar, nayalat veth trenn dasken um et trenn hemm: re vysker o gor fedh, eth re dhyvullar. Vess ull re dhyvull nahos. Re lymm en scaelur ey trenndholm hyo um ey sestow sost, eth nath re hebb ey o lom, somm nath re esk et sedh um et trenn dasken tul.
english: In one night it went under, as if the fen had only been waiting. A town is but the last course on the old, we used to say, and laugh. That night no one laughed. My grandmother carried her course-stone out on her own back, and would not give it me till the fen had closed over the last course.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Lurrvard.
english: **Holtward.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vorr o ul o vesketh, eth re ommant et flenneth ul vorr um et haldorrol sa re lunnar. Re hadhom en narl um et mesk dasken sa re ston tul. Re yal sast et mesk dhaedh, hosen garl hossen.
english: It burned in its trees, and the leaves came down burning on the wall-walk we had swept. I laid mine hand on the last tree standing. Its bark was as warm as a living hand.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Kethow Stellath.
english: **Carnhold.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Re vorr o ul o runnowath. Ul hinnarorrol et drunnardath re hunnom et drunnath ul hessyl, drunnow eth drunnow. Re wont et drunndholm dasken fedh lyss, hosel.
english: It burned in its smithies. In the street of the smiths I heard the hammers stop, one forge and then the next. The last anvil rang a while alone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull nath re wont o.
english: Then it did not ring.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Tavow Vorr.
english: **Emberhythe.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Lesk bress re heth o um et orrow sa vorr, eth lo dhrenn et grem re aedh et trenn lor, dhaedh um et trun naesket. Amm re omm o, re lymm tolmard hyor crynir vorrat hyo ul o havul. Re vyskym lo: Vorr o.
english: Five months it held on its burning shore, and the column wintered with us, warm on the bare ground. When it fell, a mason of ours carried a charred plank out in his pack. I told him to burn it.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Grullsorth.
english: **Sandreach.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Saler eth saler re yal griket hyor. Gor vess re firrym, eth en rern um et pressir, eth re hunnom et saler ul susk ul morrol, somm nath re rarr hos haskard tul. Ul et dask re rarrar hyo ul et domm, lo visk et thykir. Gor vess hy ull re aedhym um et trun lunnat, eth en rern umo.
english: Gallery by gallery it was taken from us. Each night I lay with mine ear to the floor, and heard the gallery above me go ere any runner came. At the last we came out in the dark at the canyon's foot. Every night since, I have slept on the open ground, with mine ear to it.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Frennvar.
english: **Rimewatch.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et crest hosast re yal griket. Re vorr et hellur strom um et lynth, eth et grellereth ul vorr tul. Disker eth disker re orr et vorr, hosen re orr tymornel en modha ul et hedh. Re vorr o hosen re yal baeg gor fedh.
english: On the first ice it was taken. The great hall burned on the mere with its lamps yet lit. Window by window the fire went, as my mother's taper went at dusk. It burned as it had always shone.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et dhidh re orrom, dem ey disker, eth re rikym dem vimm ey greller. Re yal o ul vorr.
english: Into the smoke I went, to her window, and took down her lamp. It was lit.

label: Romanisation
rom: Hy ull re hylym dem et orrow. Re yal et crest clenn, eth hos vess lo. Lo dhrenn et lynth tunn re wrodh o ul vimm misk, deld, eth hy ull virr. Hos fedh re rik et helvhoss et vem dem vimm dem et prelor, eth re hadhom en narl um gor lern et vem, eth re ston pawast. Ul sestow re omm et crisur. Ul lern nath re yal baegyth veth et hos ul en narl.
english: Then I turned for the shore. The ice was new, a night old. All the way across the mere it spake under me, far off and then near. Once the wind took the flame down to the wick, and I put mine hand about it till it stood again. Behind me the roof went in. Before me there was no light but the one in mine hand.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re heth et crest.
english: The ice held.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re lymmym et greller hyo ul vorr. Hedh eth hedh hy ull re syndalom o um et hald bridlernen, eth lestir o et vessvar.
english: I carried the lamp out lit. Every dusk since, I have lit it on the north wall, and the night-watch steer by it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Doss maver vothol reller um hos.
english: Someone must keep a light.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Taldow Helv.
english: **Highreach.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul lern et wemmeth darr et helvhoss. Hos orl tunn tevar hyont re vummom et myst umo, eth orl ull nath re yal galat lor veth orrol. Re orrar dem vimm bystireth et gynteth ul et domm, eth et tevath um ol sestowath. Ul sestow re stonant et bemmerdeth ul vorr um et gynteth.
english: Before the sails cometh the wind. A whole day ahead of them I smelled the grey on it, and there was naught to do with that day but go. Down the crag-stairs we came in the dark, with the children on our backs. Behind us the cranes stood burning on the crags.

label: Romanisation · the part
rom: Sirrvell.
english: **Glasspire.**

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et sulv hosast re omm o ul hos vess ul o nyrulath sost, pell eth sirr olen. Firr et domm ul o vimm, lunnat tul. Myskent merr sa re hollarant: Re ston dhenn ul neld ul et myst vess ull, strom hy gor sceth. Re yalom um wystir dasken et pell, eth et sirr ul mommol umom ul saedeleth, eth et sulv olen.
english: At the first snows it went down in one night into its own cellars, spire and glass together. The dark beneath it lieth open yet. Some that fled say a shadow stood off in the fog that night, greater than any hull. I was on the last stair of the spire, with the glass coming down about me in pieces, and the snow with it.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re veskym virr. Re veskym nayalat.
english: I looked close. I saw nothing.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Hy ull re resk Pellow, eth o sirr ul o simm, eth nath re heth o o dem susk. O reskow lo et tolm, re hebb o o lom.
english: *Then Pellow sat down with his glass in his lap, and held it not up. His place at the stone he gave to me.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo orl dasken et cumm, amm nath re yal galdol ullen lo pa yarl dholmard, re orr et Stonwrytan hyo lo et ganna gaeden. Re lymm bresketh ul so havulath, eth nayalat ullen. Ul sestow gor uld re orrant et prassath. Re ridhent so wirnenneth, hosen ul sestow pyskorn gor orl, eth re eskent so ul roval dem et orrol.
english: On the last day of every haven, when a mason's hands could do no more, the guild went out by the landward gate. Chisels they carried in their packs, and naught beside. Last went the masters. They had cleaned their trowels, as after every day's work, and wrapped them in sacking against the road.

label: Romanisation
rom: Nath re yorr et Stonwrytan. Re orr, eth nayalat ullen; eth re yalom ul so volt.
english: The Stonewrights did not fight. They simply walked; and I was among them.

label: Romanisation
rom: Et hultereth, nath re lymm et Stonwrytan so. Re ferrent et prassath hulter et cumm um o hald ul mommol, hosen esk essa et vorr ul ey vess dasken ul lest ey odha, hosen gor vess. Doss hulter stinet dem o yaldat, eth nath morr o hyo.
english: The staffs they carried not. The masters leaned each haven's staff against its falling wall, as a woman banketh the fire on her last night in her mother's house, the same as every night. A staff is cut for its work, and leaveth not its work.

label: Romanisation
rom: Re yal noth hulter, eth nath re rarr hos dem susk et brunn.
english: Ten staffs there were, and not one came up the mountain.

label: Romanisation · the words set in
rom: Re hadh Kael pa yarl umo pawast, eth re hadh o et Orrol.
english: *Kael laid his hands on it again, and told the Road.*

label: Romanisation
rom: Amm re orr Sirrvell, re hyl et trenn dem susk et brunn. Cumm eth cumm re vest o, eth ul et dask nath re yal cumm ul o sestow. Bress re yalar ul et hiskenneth.
english: When Glasspire was gone, the column turned up the mountain. Haven by haven it had gathered, till behind it no haven was left. A month were we in the passes.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul vess et hiskenn, vess brid sost et orrol, re sennent tevath mest. Re sennent merr hy et hemmeth lo so sest. So hovvath, re hebbent so lo et tevath.
english: On the night of the pass, the coldest of the road, many of the children died. Some of the old died with them. Their cloaks they had given the children.

label: Romanisation
rom: Ul et ryst re omm et sulv tul. Re dhaldar hyo, gor uld sa re yal taldol lo, eth re orrar.
english: In the morning the snow fell yet. We rose out of it, as many as could rise, and walked.

label: Romanisation
rom: Lo visk et hiskenneth re nydhym ol, eth re nydhym ol lo wisk. Nath gadhom los vodh re yal ul lodh et pa nydhyl.
english: At the foot of the passes I counted us, and I counted us at the top. I will not tell you the difference.

label: Romanisation · the laying
rom: Cadhom o hosen re yal cadhat lom.
english: This I lay as it was laid for me.

label: Romanisation · the hearth’s answer
rom: Eth re vysk et odh: Tumar.
english: *And the hearth said: We remember.*
